description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET 9 (net9.0) to .NET 10 LTS (net10.0)

tasks.description: Upgrade PhotoAlbum and PhotoAlbum.Tests from .NET 9 (net9.0) to .NET 10 LTS (net10.0)
tasks.reason: .NET 9 is a Standard Term Support (STS) release that reached end of support on May 12, 2026. As of the plan creation date, the project is running on an unsupported runtime. Upgrading to .NET 10 LTS ensures long-term support through at least May 2027 (3-year LTS window), continued security patches, and access to the latest platform APIs and performance improvements.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade both projects in the PhotoAlbum solution (PhotoAlbum and PhotoAlbum.Tests) from net9.0 to net10.0. This includes updating the TargetFramework in all .csproj files, upgrading NuGet packages with version dependencies on .NET 9 (e.g., Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.*, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory) to their .NET 10 compatible versions, and resolving any breaking API changes between .NET 9 and .NET 10.
